objective: Verify Film Grunge and Add Noise CPU Composition output and visible alpha-edge response using prepared synthetic RGBA fixtures and paired effect-off baselines.

scope.render_path: Composition CPU rasterizer surface path through ArtifactAbstractEffect::applyToCpuSurface; raw frame PNG exports from the running application, not a source-equation model.

effects.name: Film Grunge
effects.neutral: grainAmount=0, scratchAmount=0, dustAmount=0, flicker=0, gateWeave=0, vignette=0, stain=0
effects.candidate: grainAmount=.075, grainSize=1.4, seed=1977, frame 0; other controls zero.

effects.name: Add Noise
effects.neutral: Amount=0, Size=1.4, Color Noise=false, Monochrome=true, Seed=1977
effects.candidate: Amount=.075, Size=1.4, Color Noise=false, Monochrome=true, Seed=1977.

comparison.baseline: Same layer, project, frame, and background with both effects disabled; plus each effect enabled at neutral values to check neutral response.
comparison.ground_truth: No approved look target. Paired disabled output is the visual/pixel baseline only.
comparison.acceptance: No visual pass/fail threshold is set. Report alpha-region differences, source/effect output alpha, rendered RGB differences, and qualitative visible exterior/edge changes. Do not label an alpha anomaly a defect until the actual descriptor and blend contract are known.

materials.generated_by: prepare_film_runtime_capture.py; synthetic assets at 512x256 and 1024x512, SHA-256 recorded in its manifest.
materials.rights: Synthetic diagnostic assets; no external image rights.
materials.regions: ROI masks are generated from the exact quantized alpha-edge source fixture at 512x256 and 1024x512: whole frame, transparent exterior, low alpha, edge transition, near opaque, opaque interior, central fine-line/detail region, and flat opaque foreground patch.

conditions.frame: Composition frame 0; fixed seed 1977; record project frame rate.
conditions.resolution: 512x256 base alpha fixture. 1024x512 alpha fixture is a secondary still-resolution check, not expected to have identical pixel grain scale.
conditions.color_and_alpha: PNG assets carry straight RGBA8 per PNG convention. Record import/image-layer metadata if visible. Export flattened PNGs over each of three backgrounds, preserving exact dimensions and no view transform or resize if the application permits; record any unavoidable export transform.
conditions.display: Capture Composition Viewer at 100% and 200% for visual edge review. Pixel metrics use exported PNG code values, with no cross-space claim.
conditions.parameters: Save exact displayed values, seed/evolution, active effect ID, layer transform/opacity, background values, export dimensions, and application build/version in capture manifest.

effect_correctness.method: Compare disabled, neutral enabled, and candidate exports for repeatability and expected effect-local changes; log all settings.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Neutral enabled image should match disabled within RGB8 export quantization if all neutral controls are honored; candidate response is descriptive only. Same numeric amount is not treated as matched perceived strength.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect whole images and 1:1 / 2:1 alpha-edge, flat, and line crops with equal display conditions.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic acceptance gate; report exterior speckle, edge fringe, clipping, and detail changes.

color_and_alpha.method: Export transparent candidate layer PNG where supported, inspect exported alpha/RGB, and compare flattened outputs over black/gray/white with RGB metrics per fixture alpha region.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Raw effect-entry/output float descriptor and whether PNG export changes association are not exposed by the planned UI capture; use static source path evidence and label this limit.

render_paths_and_resolution.method: Composition CPU path at two still resolutions.
render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Preview versus final/export, GPU, other backends, and multi-frame behavior.

performance.reason: No controlled warm-up, timing or memory instrumentation in this plan.
